Katne shuwa mynta katba ai buit, ai bor, ai akor 
isynei U Blei Trai Kynrad, nga thoh, nga lum la ka jingsneg 
ka akor Khasi, kaba la seng bad la rakhe pateng la pateng 
man la u shynrang bad ka kynthei ka ri naduh barim bajah, 
ban tang ioh Ta ka kynmaw kyndit bynriew, mangi mynta 
imat kumba ngi la klet noh la bun bah la ki akor babha 
bad ba donburom, ha ka thame shohtyndep ka buit khyllah 
jait mynta. Kumta bun la shu kie-berong khlem urn ha ka 
khlem akor. 


Toi ka akor kein ka long ka rukom ksiar bad ka deng 
ka kieng bakordor ha khmat u briew U Blei. Ta kane ngim 
bit ban dule bad katba nang lap nangshem hadien habud 
ruh Ta kiba sah teng bad Ta kiwei de ki akorl'aid, akoneng 
yn sa nang bynrap lang ne thoh kyrpang; to nang Ta pule 
Ta kynmaw bad Ta khiar shuwa katne katba nangiohei la 
ka akor babha ka ri la jong ko kynthei, ko shynrang, ko 
khynnah korangbah. 

Mynta shisha kane ka por ngim Tai lah Tajuk shuh 
tang da ka ktien suda kum ki barim sa ban shu Ta thoh da 
ka kot ka sla, ban ioh Ta buddien la ka akor babha, ba da 
mang ba da tang ha ka sneng ka bthah ki longshuwa 
manshuwa, ban tang sah burom malade ki kur, ki kha, 
para shnong bad para ri ha la U Blei U Trai Kynrad.

Nga sngewnguh shibun Ta kine ki rangbah para ri 
ba ki la Tarap bor bad la Ta khmih lerp to ine i kitab

KA AKOR KHASI 
I 

K O pyrsa ko iing bad ko khun ko ksiew, 
Ale! shynrang, kynthei, ngan sneng eh 

rngiew; 

Shong khop shiphang, peit beit baroh sha nga, 
Baroh la ki ’tien sneng wat ju bakla. 

Baroh kumne phi long shi para ho, 

Kynmaw ruh ban la ieit lano-Iano; 



— 2 — 


la kren, ’ticn burom baroh shipara, 

Wat ju mlicn ban ong “manic” nc “mapha’ 


II

H ABA phi ioh jingbam ia bam Jem ho, 
Wat ju bam pynsah pud i'ano iano; 
Ilaba ki ai jingbam ki kmie ki kpa. 

To shim ia bam kmen wat ju da lehsa; 
Haba kwah jingbam kum kano kano. 

Da iapan wat marmlien shim hi ho; 

La’m don jingbam lia iing kumno-kumno, 
Wat ju marmlien iaknieh leit thied hi ho 
Ba kylla runar noh de khamakha, 

Ba’m nang niewkor shuh ia la kmie la kpa 


III 


W AT ju lalot, wat ju kangar jyndei, 

Ba ioh phi ioh pang lane ioh khrew ei, 
Wat ju bam seh wat ia ka ja hi ruh, 

Ba ioh raid noh phim khlain ne santer shuh . 
Lada phi lalot lane kangar than, 

Ki briew baroh kin isih noh pynban; 



— 3 —

Man ki briew kin kynshi kin iathuhkhana, 
Kin ong, “Iw! kum ki khun ba’m ju ioh ja”. 


IV 


YkT AT ju kren ki ktien sniew, ho hep, ba 

sang. 

Bad ki khynnah bymman wat ju !alang; 

Wat ju iamai-Iania badno-badno, 

Wat ju iashoh-iadat lano-lano; 

Wat ju leit kai shangmakia eh sha jngai, 

Yaleh kai ha la phyllaw nepongshai; 

Wat kuman haba khot ki kmie ki kpa, 

Tang iohsngew bakhot, kloi phet beit shata. 

V 

B AROH shipara wat ju la bishni, 

Baroh shipara wat ju ia than si; 

Mane biang la u kpa bad la ka kmie, 

Nguh arti ia U Blei mynba dangkhie;

Mane ruh de ia kiba la tymmen, 

La ha ka jingtrei ne ha ka jingkren, 

Wat ju nangang-shitong lane iriang, 

Ya kur ia kha ruh kren, leh da ba biang. 



4 


VI 


YI7AT ju shang sha ki jaka ba mynsaw, 

»V La sha ka ding ka um, ka dieng ka maw 
loh ur ioh hap ba ioh sniew oi ka dur. 

Da sumar biang la iaid ha thieb ha jur; 

To long tipsngi ho wat ju tam pynlah, 

To ngeit biang ia ka ’ticn sneng ka ’tien bthah 
Ban laroh ki briew, ban kyrkhu U Blei, 

Naduh mynta nangne haduh lawei. 


VII 


M A phi baroh ruh ko khun ko pyrsa,

Da kumno ban kncr da kumno ban shim, 
Da kumno ban mer da kumno ban im: 

Da mut da khan, vvat sarong wat kvreii. 

La ha shnong lane ha ka wan ka leit; 

Kane kam long, ka kam thamula ne kai, 
Hynrei ka long tynrai na U Trai. 


VIII 


H IKAI ba phin khie dang step phyrngab, 

Pynmlien ban khie dang riew ka tyngab; 
Lane khie noh dang riew y, ‘iar nyngkong, 
Kynthei, shynrang khmih la jingtrei la jong; 
Phi tang shu khie thiah sliew la ka ding, 
la la ka kti ka kjat ruh to pynsting; 

To khmih to lit la ka ling bad to sar, 

Baroh kaba hapoh lane habar, 



— 6 — 


Sa thet la ki kti bad bta la ki khmat, 

Ba ka s’iem Lukhimai kan bud ryngkat; 
la khiew shet khicw tiew wat ju ktah shuti.

To pynmlien Ialade ba phin long smat. 



7 - 


X 

W AT mlien shong lyngngeit ba kyllajaituh, 
Ha ka leit ka wan ruh kylla khadduh; 
Wat ju pynmlien ban bamja pynsuki, 

Ha ban leit jingleit ruh ba ioh lap sngi: 

Wat marmlien thiah sngi ne marmlicn thiah 

sniang 

Khie la dangstep lane peitngor kyndiang; 

Ba la ka met ruh kan koil kan khiah krat. 

Bad ba ka ’rta ruh de kan slem artat; 

Wat ju shim ju ai da lyndet basang, 

Ba long kum ka kam Snaiap niam lyndang; 

Wat ju ai wat ju shim khap shynriahti, 

Ba ioh kha kap ne kha khun artyjli. 


XI

Ya u tympew wat ju khylliap lyndet. 

La lasong iaro fano ruh wat klet: 

Haba ki pan shun khyndiat bym pat biang, 

Wat ju ai da ka khmut tari basang; 

Ba long kum ka rukom knia syiar ne biang, 

Ba woit khaw khmut tari byllud ryndang; 

Shu thoh ha i tympew khyndiat sa ai, 

Kane ka rukom kiba mynhyndai. 


XIII 

H ABA phi i ba don ki briew hajan, 

Wat ju marmlien ban ieng ban laid 

kynsan; 



-9 


Haba ki shong lane ki ieng ki briew, 

Wat ju marmlien iaicl na khmai ba isniew; 
Wat ju-mlien laid kawut jainkup jainsem,

H ABA ki tyrwa jingbam ei-ei. 

Da kham ia tyngkan wat ju jham madei; 
Haba ia bamja ne bam pai bam soh, 

Lane kino ma ki jingbam baroh, 

Wat ju iehnoh sohkhaw ne snep hajuh, 

Da tarn noh bin wat ia kiba phret ruh; 

Leit bret ne leit theh shabar ba theh nuit, 
la pliang la luta da khlieng ne kyrshut; 

Sa wallam khuid ia ki ha ting jong ki, 

Buh beit biang i’a ki da lade hi. 



11 — 


XVII 

V^AT shong kai slem ha ling ki briew 

... barobor, 

Ba ioh ki sin niang-bulot khlem akor; 

La phi shong ne leit kai haei-haei,

pem. 



- 12 — 


XIX 

L A mill na ling la rung ha ling mynmiet, 
Khyrdop mian ka jmgkhang wat pynpatiot; 
Wat khyrdep dadien ne khyrdup lyndet, 

(oh long kuni ka snaiap ba trci iaphet; 

Ngeit ia ’lien sneng baroh ka babha, 

Mut, kren bad Ich ruh ia kaba shisha: 

Ta kaba dei kaba bit to ini sngi, 

Wat ju sngew ruh de ba phi shu nang hi; 

Wat iai nilicn ong ba kuni Ich ne kum kren, 
B’ka jingmut, jingkren, jingleh i uh nangrben; 
Wat ia ka kticn kai ruh wat iai nilicn ong, 

B’ia ka jingshisha ka pynshong kynrong. 


XX 


W AT ju pynmlien ban pyrsad ding

— 15 


XXIV 

WAT ju pynmlien ban kham wad phoi 

kynsha, 

Ba ka jingthmu baroh ruh ka bashla; 

Wat ju mlien khong-khong wat ju mlien iriang, 
Ba loh shun ei u kamon kadiang; 

To long ba jemnud to long ba pasiang, 

Ba kiwei ruh ia phi kin long kylliang; 

Ha ka ktien, ha ka kam, wat ju laplah, 
loh ba hangta ha shen kum kylla prah; 

Ha kano kano ruh to kham tyngkan, 

Wat madei thala loh ngat thit pynban. 


XXV 


f A lade wat ju pynshong Siangraidhoh, 

1 Ba loh dait pong la la ka lyngthohdoh; 
Wat ju leit rhah i'a ka jingioh kiwei,

Wat ju iai jyndei tang ka beh mrad, 

Ba shem kynsha eh ki briew man ka lad ; 
la ki kam shang khlaw shang lum bad 

shang wah„ 

Ki bym-nang i'aroh lane nang iashah; 

Ka kynthei ka khynnah kan tieng pynban, 

Ba dem lashem kat sha ba leit ba wan ; 

Bad ka jingkhlem akor wat ju ialang, 

Bad ka jingkhlemraifi ruh wat ju iashang. 



—17— 


XXVII 

W AT ju ai huspai ia ka kiad ban bang, 

Ba ha ka, ka um.'ka ding, ki don lang, 
Wat ju leh khlain eh ia um ka ding, 

Ba ioh phi hap pat lyndang pat pyrshing. (1) 
Wat ju samai ho ha ka dihkynja, 

Ba ioh lap ka ringsdot pukir-pukra; (2)

Wat bam wat dih aphin, shandu, inudot, 

Ba ka met ka sdot, ka r’ta ka lyngkot. (3) 
Wat ju leit marmlien ka syat iakhalai, 

Ba don ha ka ka niamra ringswai; (4) 

Wat ju mlien ha ka laid awria awman, 

Ba sniew ka met bad wir spah noh pynban. (5) 
Wat ju iashang khah bad ki iong ki briew, 

Ba ioh ka lap ka ruma ka phohsmew; (6) 

Nangta sata sa ka rain ka thuhkhana, 

Lyntertait baroh shijunom bura. 

Kine baroh hynriew tylli ki kpait, 

Kiba lah eh ban pynjot ingkhong khait. 


XXVIII 


’A la ka jinglong phin'da kham adkar, 
la kaba hapoh bad kaba habar, 



— 18 — 


W r* iu leit shah ba kan shu im lyngkar,

Wi.i > i 1 'r-it shah ruh ba kan kai pathar; 
Bad kaao ka bym hok, ka bym slusha, 

Wat ju leit mlien ialok bad kum kata, 

La kaba thiang kaba bang kum ka ngap, 
Na ka, to kiar kham jngai ne to phet lap; 
Kaba i'ashang khah khah ka pynman thit.

XXIX 


VXZATju iapoi kha lyngngoh thamula, 

’ ’ Ka dei ban da tip da u kfii u kpa;

XXXIII 


D A thew la jingkren jingiaid bad jingleh, 

Ba kan long kum ka jingkynshew ba neh; 
Wat ju leh than ka kamai kajih, 

Wat ju lut phut ha ka bam ha ka dih; 

Ba i'oh ka hap lynnong ka jingshipa, 

Ba loh lap lum thadlad khlem kur khlem kha. 
Wat lalir lorni ia ka kam kiwei, 

Ba loh shet khongpong lade ka pyrthei; 

To im sngi tang la la ka jong ka hok,

Ba la phi im phi lap ruh kan don bok; 
Kano kano ka ktien ruh wat lalir, 

Kano kano ka kam ruh wat bukhir; 

Wat pynshong ftiangkuhiw la ka dohnud, 

Ho shynrang kynthei, ho khynraw khyllud! 



- 22 — 


XXXIV 

W AT shaniah jyndei tang ha la ka mon, 

Haramjat, kum ka mon lait luid yro ju don,. 
Ka mon khlem nia kam ju fiiew la ka sang, 

Wat t’u pud ki bari’m ka nud ryngkang; 

Wat la kita ki khun binong bishon, 

Ka nud shisha shisha ban shet ban phon, 

Wat la kita ki khun bakhraw batri, 

Ka nud shisha shisha ban khawoit kti: 

To Idng ba sian bad to laid da ka nia. 

La lap la im ha ka hok to lengtia;

Hei khun pyrsa ha mon lait luid wat aili 
Suidnia, fawbei, Thawlang ruh kin diangti 


XXXV 


L ADA nang lane lada tip makna, 

Haba phim don satia ka jingshisha^ 
Lada phi loh makna ka spah shi pyrtbei, 
Haba la lade phi die tat kynrei; 

Lada deng da kup makna thabalain, 

Wei sahjit I’i long rynieng ha ka rain. 

La ioh makna shongkulai shonghati, 

Haba phim khmihthuh la ka jinglong hi; 



— 23 — 


Lada phi bat niam nguh arti makna,

Lada phi paw nam makna ba pyrthei,

Haba phim mut, phim kren, phim leh shong 

Blei; 

Kumno phin lait na ka jingmai U Blei, 

Lada naduh nangne ne naduh lawei ? 

Kumno phin lait na ka rkhie beifi rahrong, 
Jong u bamih ~basep baroh sawdong ? 


XXXVI 


K ANE ka phuhmut phuhmat mangkarong. 
Long ka kpait thawjot la tynrai la jong; 
Lada ka tynrai lajong ka la jot, 

Kat sha kaba phi thew phin shorn apot: 

Ka Jong briew man briew ka neh ha tynrai, 
Haduh hadien habud naduh hyndai; 

Ko kur ko kha ba ha ling ba ha sem, 

Kiar na ka pat kynsha ha it ha them; 

Ha ka riam ka pah u kamon u kadiang, 

To sian to nang sharai lade kyndiang;

— 24 - 


Tang sah ka hok ha khmat U Blei bathaw, 
Naduh mynta phin kyndit phin kynmaw. 

XXXVII 

T O wat lai im sngi tang ha ka kit nong, 

Ba ban pynbieit u star haduh dyngkhong; 
Wat im jingmut jyndei tang ka bylla, 

Ba bieit anna-antu noh khamakha; 

Wat sngewbha shong thapbam ha ling ki 

briew, 

Ba jah jait noh de la i jong i rngiew; 

Wat leit hap ha ka shong mraw shong shakri, 
Ioh pateng pakit kynnoh pohrati; 

To sumar la ka jong ka rep ka ri, 

Tang roi tang pa la ka spah nongkynti, 

To minot la ka jihgthaw ka jingshna, 

Ban roi la ka jingmut bad ban manbha. 

XXXVIII 

T O hikai fa la ka khafi ka pateng,

W AT iehnoh lok ha ka jingleit jingwan, 
la leit tawan ryngkat la jngai ne jan; 
Lada jia kaei kaei ha lynti,. 

Da !a synran-synriah ha kjat ha kti; 

To kynmaw dngong la ka akor babha. 

Ban tang sah ka pyrto baroh shirta; 

U briew U Blei ruh Un kyrkhu laphi, 

Phin sah ka nam kum u bnai kum ka sngi, 
Wat phin da lap ruh shu sah ka pyrto, 

Ka khanatang shu uto ne kato. 



—26— 

XL 


K A akor babha kein pura syrtok, 

Kaba lah teh kur, teh kha da ka hok; 
Ka akor babha kein ha ka pyrthei, 

Kaba pynwan jingkyrkhu na U Blei; 
la kane ka jingsneng wat pynpute, 

Ko khun ko pyrsa hei wat ju dule: 

Phi ruh to sneng pateng ia khun la ksiew.

Kane dei ka dhorom mynsiem bad met. 

Phi ko khun ko pyrsa phim dei ban klet. 
H’ka Dhorom neh khieu pyllun shipyrthei, 
Naduh hyndai kulong haduh lawei.
